_doc: Tools/produce_fighter_clips.py spec. Canvas px: the guard key is scaled so the figure is body_px tall, feet centred on (body_x, feet_y). Keys are Qwen Image Edit 2.1 edits of the guard key; every action is chained MiniMax H3 first/last-frame segments between keys, so the contact frame is a segment boundary. Segment frames must be 8n+1 (24 fps).
look: the stocky dwarf brewmaster with white braided hair and brass goggles, blue earrings, a blue patterned bandeau top with a leather harness, leather gauntlets, denim shorts, knee guards, heavy boots and a glowing crystal dwarf war hammer

guard.stance: feet planted wide, knees bent, the dwarf war hammer held in both hands across her body, a confident grin

basic_hit.pose: the end of a forward hammer swing: the dwarf war hammer swung low and forward to the right with both hands as if sending a wave across the ground, knees bent

cast_hit.pose: casting frost: her free hand thrust forward to the right with the palm open, the war hammer resting on her shoulder in the other hand

support.pose: a cheerful blessing: she raises the war hammer high overhead in one hand, the other hand on her hip, laughing warmly

slam.pose: she slams the war hammer down onto the ground in front of her with both hands, crouched low, braids flying up

block.pose: a braced block: the war hammer held up across in front of her body with both hands, feet planted wide

hit.pose: recoiling from a heavy hit: her head and shoulders snapped back toward the left side of the picture, eyes squeezed shut in pain, arms flung open, her weight thrown onto her back foot

down.pose: knocked out: she lies collapsed on her side on the ground with her eyes closed and her limbs slack, her head toward the right side of the picture, the whole body lying along the same ground line

victory.pose: a victory pose: the war hammer propped on her shoulder, giving a big thumbs up with a hearty laugh

segments: She stands planted with the hammer ready, breathing steadily, braids swaying, a warm grin. A subtle idle loop: she ends exactly as she began.
She is struck hard and recoils backward to the left.
She shakes off the hit and recovers into her fighting stance.
She snaps her weapon up in front of her to block.
She lowers her guard and returns to her fighting stance.
She is knocked off her feet and collapses onto the ground, lying still.
She straightens up and strikes a triumphant victory pose.
She swings the war hammer low and forward to the right, sending a wave across the ground.
She recovers and returns to her fighting stance.
She rests the hammer on her shoulder and thrusts her open palm forward to the right, casting frost.
She recovers and returns to her fighting stance.
She raises the war hammer high overhead and laughs, blessing her friends.
She lowers the hammer and returns to her stance.
She heaves the war hammer up overhead and slams it down onto the ground in front of her.
She recovers and returns to her fighting stance.
